defs.def: sweet food made of sugar and/or chocolate, eaten between meals; a piece of this 糖果；巧克力；一块糖（或巧克力）

ex.s: His grandmother filled his backpack with candy to make him a little less____30____ .
ex.t: 杨女士为什么想要记录父母的食谱？（不超过15个词）

ex.s: They were surprised that he had saved some candy and was able to think about the candy during the____32____ .
ex.t: 杨女士做了什么来帮助唐人街的餐馆？请举例说明。（不超过15个词）

ex.s: For the second test, in one case the thin actor took two pieces of candy from the snack bowls.
ex.t: 在第二次测试中，有一次瘦演员从零食碗中拿了两块糖果。

ex.s: The results were similar to the first test: the participants followed suit but took significantly more candy when the thin actor took 30 pieces.
ex.t: 结果与第一次测试相似：参与者们纷纷效仿，但当瘦演员拿30块糖果时，他们拿的糖果明显更多。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
On the outing, she was offered a candy bar.
ex.t: 获取企业利益     D. 帮助有需要的社区

ex.s: But Moore was sick of missing out on candies.
ex.t: 一切始于摩尔和她爸爸一起去银行的时候。

ex.s: So she desired to get round the warning, "Why can't I make a healthy candy that's good for my teeth so that my parents can't say no to it?" With that in mind, Moore asked her dad if she could start her own candy company.
ex.t: 在那次外出中，有人给了她一块糖。

ex.s: He recommended that she do some research and talk to dentists about what a healthier candy would contain.
ex.t: 然而，爸爸提醒她含糖零食对牙齿不好。

ex.s: Consequently, she succeeded in making a kind of candy only using natural sweeteners, which can reduce oral bacteria.
ex.t: 他建议她先做一些研究，并与牙医谈谈更健康的糖果应该包含什么成分。

ex.s: Moore is enthusiastic about the candy she created, and she's also positive about what the future might bring.
ex.t: 然后摩尔用她的积蓄创办了自己的企业。

ex.s: It is sweeter than other candies.
the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied
She'd put tokens in some dumplings: candies for a sweet life and peanuts for a long and healthy one.
ex.t: 她在有些饺子里包了寓意物：糖代表生活甜蜜，花生代表健康长寿。

ex.s: Sweetmeats are candies while sweetbreads, which aren’t sweet, are meat.
ex.t: sweetmeats（蜜饯）是糖果，而 sweetbreads（杂碎）并不甜，是肉。

ex.s: Visiting the candy shop and trying some of the same kind of candy that American southerners made 150 years ago is a rare experience.
ex.t: 参观糖果店、尝一尝150年前美国南方人制作的同种糖果，是一种难得的体验。

ex.s: The American Heart Association recommends that we limit ourselves to less than 100–150 calories a day from sugar, which is less than what is usually contained in one can of sweet drink or in a single candy bar.
ex.t: 美国心脏协会建议我们把每天从糖中摄取的热量限制在100–150卡路里以下，这少于一罐甜饮料或一块糖果通常所含的量。

ex.s: Listening and writing Ron McCartney, CEO of Candy Corporation, is being interviewed about the sales of the company's ChocoLoco chocolate bar.
ex.t: 听与写　糖果公司的首席执行官罗恩·麦卡特尼正在接受采访，话题是公司奇科洛科巧克力棒的销售情况。
